title: The Two Tiny Coins
reflectionQuestion: The woman's two coins were tiny, but Jesus said she gave the most of all. I wonder what small thing you could give to someone, with all your heart?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (filed under Jesus' Parables as the de-facto Jesus-teaching bucket; it is an event, not a parable). Adam's tweak baked in: sound-forward visual -- big coins go 'Clink! Clink! Clink!', the widow's two go 'Ting. Ting.', then Jesus smiled (kids remember sounds). Do NOT shame the rich -- LIFT the widow; room = small gift given with whole heart is the biggest of all / you are enough. Widowhood named gently ('her husband had died'). Soft close ('precious to him'). VOICE_MARTHA_CARING (warm, down-to-earth, female -- fits the humble widow).
